title: gate-registered-iwad-when-present
liveReferenceCommandApplicability: N/A — gate-registered-iwad-when-present is a pure deterministic bun test gate, intentionally NOT registered in LIVE_REFERENCE_TEST_PATHS and capturing no live Win32 window, so the conditional `bun run plan_final/test-live-reference.ts ...` verification command does not apply to this step.
resolution: The registered DOOM IWAD (DOOM.WAD, 27 maps / 3 episodes) is proprietary and never bundled — the C1 product target is shareware (PRIMARY_TARGET.gameMode 'shareware', DOOM1.WAD). The registered parity smoke is intrinsically conditional: it runs `bun run doom.ts -iwad iwad/DOOM.WAD` ONLY when the user supplies iwad/DOOM.WAD, and is correctly SKIPPED (not failed) when absent. The gate proves that conditional behaviour deterministically, each zero-difference: (1) the registered-IWAD scope contract (PRIMARY_TARGET shareware; registered is a separate user-supplied DOOM.WAD ≠ DOOM1.WAD; committed REGISTERED_IWAD_MAP_BUNDLE_COUNT 27 / REGISTERED_IWAD_EPISODE_COUNT 3; smoke command = bun run doom.ts -iwad iwad/DOOM.WAD); (2) the shareware iwad/DOOM1.WAD copy present in this env is NOT a registered IWAD (committed isRegisteredIwad false, mapBundleCount ≠ 27, episode2/3 map count 0) so the registered smoke correctly stays gated off even though a .WAD exists under iwad/; (3) the registered parity smoke is presence-gated (present ? test : test.skip) and correctly SKIPPED in this env since no user-supplied iwad/DOOM.WAD exists — the gate-passing state per the step goal 'only when present'. Focused gate PASSED 3 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail (15 expect()s); validate-plan 33/0; tsc 0; format clean. Note: a parallel Ralph worker was active on the 13-009 progress log only (no commit advance, HEAD==origin==c7d44ae); verify-then-yield — this agent had verified evidence and committed.
